entries.topic: The definition fight: adoption, opposition and status

claims.text: CAM 2025 report: 1,334 adoptions worldwide by 31 Dec 2025; 47 countries; 37 US states (18 legislation, 19 executive); 386 educational institutions; 67 new in 2025; Ireland 26th EU state, Malta the only EU state not; Harvard, Yale, Columbia adopted in 2025; NYC's adoption rescinded Jan 2026; European Commission, Parliament, Council of Europe, OAS adopted.
JDA released 25 Mar 2021; drafting from June 2020; core definition; 15 guidelines in three sections; ~200 initial signatories; criticisms (Hirsh, Nelson, Steinberg/Romirowsky).
Apr 2023: 104 organizations (founding 13 incl. ACLU, Amnesty, HRW, B'Tselem, Adalah, Al-Haq) urged UN not to adopt IHRA; cite Achiume.
EO 'Additional Measures to Combat Anti-Semitism' 29 Jan 2025 expands EO 13899 (Dec 2019); Title VI inventory; visa inadmissibility; institutions may monitor and report alien students.
2 Jan 2026: Mamdani revoked Adams's IHRA and anti-boycott orders; kept Office to Combat Antisemitism; Israeli consul general Akunis criticized; CAIR-NY welcomed.
